title: Light
summary: Light travels in straight lines, bounces off mirrors, bends through lenses and hides a rainbow inside white light. From shadows and pinhole cameras to periscopes, magnifying glasses and a laser maze.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Simple models of how light travels and reflects let us explain what we see and design instruments that extend our vision.

factual: What is the law of reflection?
What colours make up white light?
conceptual: How can a ray model explain shadows, images and rainbows?
Why do different mirrors and lenses form different kinds of image?
debatable: Is what we see ever the ‘real’ object?
Should mirror-writing (like AMBULANCE) be used more on vehicles and signs?
